nodes.label: App Icon Brand Identity (Food Plate)
nodes.description: Primary app icon for kalori_takip (calorie tracker). Shows a stylized food plate on a circular light-blue (#E8F4FB) background with thick black outlines and a flat/cartoon illustration style. The plate contains: a grilled steak (brown #8B4513 with diagonal grill marks), green leafy garnish (dark green #2D6A4F), two red cherry tomatoes (#E63946), and yellow-orange side items (fries/bread, #F4A261). No text visible. Design language: bold outlines, vibrant flat colors, food-themed iconography consistent with a nutrition/calorie tracking app.
nodes.design_style: flat cartoon illustration, bold black outlines, circular composition

nodes.label: Android Platform Icons (launcher_icon + ic_launcher)
nodes.description: Android launcher icons across densities: mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi. launcher_icon uses the custom food-plate brand icon. ic_launcher uses the default Flutter logo (light-blue geometric chevron shapes on white, with dark navy lower piece) — indicating ic_launcher was not customized. Resolutions: 48x48 (mdpi) through 192x192 (xxxhdpi).

nodes.label: iOS Platform Icons
nodes.description: iOS app icons across all required sizes: 20x20@1x, 20x20@2x, 20x20@3x, 29x29@1x, up to 1024x1024@1x. All use the custom food-plate brand icon on a white/transparent square background (iOS applies rounded corners at OS level). The 1024px version is used for App Store submission.

nodes.label: macOS Platform Icons
nodes.description: macOS app icons across sizes: 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024px. Uses the default Flutter logo (light-blue geometric chevrons on white rounded square, dark navy accent) — the macOS variant was not updated to the custom food-plate brand icon. This represents a branding inconsistency: Android and iOS use the custom food icon; macOS still shows the Flutter default.

nodes.label: Flutter Default Launcher Icon (ic_launcher)
nodes.description: Default Flutter framework logo used as ic_launcher on Android and as the macOS app icon. Design: white/light rounded-square background, two light-blue (#54C5F8) diagonal parallelogram shapes forming a stylized left-pointing chevron/arrow, with a dark navy (#0175C2) lower triangle. Represents unbranded Flutter scaffold — not the custom app identity.

nodes.label: iOS App Icon Set (AppIcon.appiconset)
nodes.description: 16 resolution variants of the iOS app icon (29x29@2x, 29x29@3x, 40x40@1x, 40x40@2x, 40x40@3x, 50x50@1x, 50x50@2x, 57x57@1x, 57x57@2x, 60x60@2x, 60x60@3x, 72x72@1x, 72x72@2x, 76x76@1x, 76x76@2x, 83.5x83.5@2x). All variants show the same flat-illustrated icon: a circular badge with a light blue background depicting a grilled steak on a dinner plate, accompanied by green vegetables (broccoli/salad greens), small red garnishes (tomatoes), and a fork/cutlery element. The design uses bold outlines and a warm brown/orange palette for the steak, establishing a food-focused brand identity for the calorie-tracking app.

nodes.label: Kalori Takip App Brand Identity
nodes.description: The visual brand identity of the Kalori Takip (Calorie Tracking) app, a Turkish-language food diary and calorie counter. Brand is communicated through a food-plate icon featuring grilled meat and vegetables on a light blue circular background, conveying health, nutrition, and meal tracking. The flat-illustration style and warm color palette position the app as approachable and food-centric.
